title: SoulsCrafter
description: A mod that brings the Dark Souls mechanics into Minecraft while keeping it vanilla
body:
**SoulsCrafter** brings the core mechanics of _Dark Souls_ to Minecraft. not built to be fun, but a challenge

This is rather made for those who are _familiar with the system_ used in games like Dark Souls

## Basic controls
- Scroll = cycle right-hand weapon     
- Shift + Scroll = left hand     
- Alt+Scroll = quick item
- V use the selected quick item (Estus, food, etc.)
- C while running to Leap aka soulsjump (it has it's benefits)

This mod bring core _**Dark Souls**_ mechanics to Minecraft which include things such as: 
- Infinite Inventory
- Equip Load
- Poise
- Custom Mob attack patterns
- Rings
- Staggers
- Waripng
- Leveling system
- Level Scaling
- Weapon Scaling
- Dark Souls equipment jingles

This was created out of boredom with the usual Minecraft gameplay. So this was rather made as a challenge to beat the game with these mechanics instead
